description: Pixel art background: a late-night TV home shopping broadcast studio in red and black lacquer with gold trim, seen at a three-quarter angle from slightly above. The image is split by a slanted diagonal line running from the left edge down to the bottom edge near the right. Below and left of that line is the empty raised stage floor, its front edge running along the line. Above and right of it, lower than the stage and facing it, is the studio audience area: many long rows of studio audience chairs on carpeted risers, each row a step higher than the one in front, running past the top and right edges, all empty. Pack the whole image with detail everywhere: audience area, walls and corners all full of set dressing, decoration and texture, a slightly eerie TV broadcast studio with real depth. Everything else is up to you. Rich lighting with clear shadows. Dense, highly detailed pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, selective dark outline, rich shading, no dithering, no blur. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
